# VedicMindAI

> India's AI-powered Vedic Mathematics, Reasoning & Aptitude learning platform — for school students (Class 1–12) and competitive exam aspirants (SSC, JEE, CAT, UPSC).

VedicMindAI combines 3,000-year-old Vedic Mathematics techniques with modern AI personalisation to help students calculate 10× faster. The platform includes 40 structured Vedic Maths lessons across 4 levels, an AI Personal Tutor, Daily Quiz, Battle Mode, Olympiad, and Reasoning & Aptitude tracks. Available as a web app and on Google Play Store.

- [Pricing](https://www.vedicmindai.in/pricing): Free plan and subscription options
- [Reviews](https://www.vedicmindai.in/reviews): Student and parent testimonials
